audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer rates it HARD 8/10 yet the packet shows 50.2% WR over 2693 games and both content and packet charts give Ryze more rows than Yasuo. Rating left alone (enum, defensible as play-difficulty since Wind Wall blocks both damage spells), but the chart contradiction is fixed.
audit.why: Wind Wall makes it mechanically punishing without making it statistically losing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried 'Yasuo' on all seven rows; content and packet both say Yasuo,Skill,Ryze,Skill,Skill,Ryze,Ryze.
audit.why: Level 3 Flux-root burst beats him before dashes matter; 6 is even because Last Breath needs an airborne target; items favor Ryze (root shuts the dash-crit pattern).
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 sides aligned with matching why and rating rewrites; win[] already correct so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] claimed Yasuo has 'no self-ult' / needs a knockup partner — false: his own third-Q whirlwind knocks airborne and enables his R solo. spikes[0] had a garbled parenthetical 'Wind Wall (E on minions/Q dash)' mixing three abilities, and omitted that Ryze W needs Flux (E) first to root.
audit.why: Kit Q text: 'At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne'; R text: 'Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion'. Ryze W text: root only 'if the target has Flux'.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in whys[4], spikes[0], spikes[1]; Wind Wall 4s duration / 25s rank-1 cooldown and Sweeping Blade same-target lockout added to cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d referenced 'a Zed mark' in a Yasuo matchup.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and the root ends him: W shuts the dash-crit pattern, Q-resets melt him, Realm Warp answers his flanks.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rune Prison has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s max, blocks projectiles for 4s — your Q and E both die on it; hold poke until it is spent. - Sweeping Blade cannot re-dash the same target for a few seconds — root him then. - Your W is the dash-chain stop; your R is the exit.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: Wind Wall lasts 4s on a 25s cooldown — a 1000-range Q spent baiting it buys the real combo a 20-second window.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.
edits.after: Your root is your only 'stop' button — hold it for the dash-chain, not the poke before it.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: Every minion is a Sweeping Blade dash for him — inside his wave he closes for free and your Flux burst has no room.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the map game. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Skill: level 6 offers him no self-ult, keeping the duel even barring a gank.
edits.after: Skill: his R only follows a Q3 knockup — dodge the whirlwind and 6 stays even.

edits.before: Level 3 is your spike: Yasuo has no dash target off you directly, so W (Rune Prison) roots him in place and your Q-E-Q bursts him before Wind Wall (E on minions/Q dash) matters. His Windwall (W) can eat one Q, so bait it or fire your second Q after it drops, and never feed his Flow shield by poking into full stacks.
edits.after: Level 3 is your spike: land Flux (E) first so W (Rune Prison) roots him in place, then Q-E-Q bursts him before his Sweeping Blade minion-dashes matter. Wind Wall (W) eats one Q, so bait it or fire the second Q after its 4 seconds expire, and never feed his Flow shield by poking into full stacks.

edits.before: Even window: his Last Breath (R) needs an airborne target, so without a knockup partner he cannot ult you off your own combo. Respect his all-in only if the jungler ganks; solo, your W root plus burst still wins if his Windwall is down.
edits.after: Even window: Last Breath (R) needs an airborne target — his own third-Q whirlwind provides it, so that dodge matters twice. Sidestep the Q3 and he has no ult; solo, your W root plus burst still wins when his Wind Wall (25s) is down.

notes: Ryze Q and E are both projectiles (kit flags) — Wind Wall genuinely blanks the whole damage kit, which is why diff stays HARD despite 50.2% WR; flagged in point 2 rather than edited. Content 'mid' also says 'W root plus Q-E-Q' without naming the Flux prerequisite but is directionally fine — left within band.
